headings.usage: Hero sections, product titles, major section headers. MUST use tracking-tight.

body.usage: Paragraphs, UI labels, AI metrics, technical specs.

accent.usage: AI Match Scores, microcopy, tech tags, loading text.

typography.instructions: Avoid generic sans-serif for headings. Never use 'Inter' for headings. Never center default headings.

colors.instructions: Do not use generic SaaS blue or AI purple (#7351B7). Stick to the stark contrast of #F9F9F6 and #121212 with #0033FF for AI highlights.

visual_enhancers: Grid Borders (Technical Look): Expose the skeleton for tech/AI sections. Use border-collapse style layouts with 1px border-border.
Generous whitespace (p-8 to p-12) for product breathing room. Cramped elements feel cheap.
Images should have no border radius (sharp edges) to maintain an editorial, high-fashion look.
Use monochromatic geometric labels for AI recommendations.

components_instructions.buttons: Sharp corners (rounded-none). Primary: bg-[#121212] text-white hover:bg-[#0033FF] hover:text-white transition-colors. Secondary: border border-[#121212] bg-transparent text-[#121212].
components_instructions.cards: Flat, 1px border-[#E5E5E5], bg-white, no shadow. Sharp corners (rounded-none).
components_instructions.ai_score_badge: Monospace font, bg-[#0033FF] text-white, px-2 py-1 text-xs uppercase tracking-widest.
components_instructions.inputs: Shadcn standard but override radius to rounded-none. 1px border-[#E5E5E5] focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#0033FF].
components_instructions.modals_drawers: Use Radix/Shadcn Sheet for the Assess panel and Filters. Flat white background, no outer shadow, 1px left border.

grids_and_layouts.discover_feed: Bento Grid Mode A (Tetris Grid). Asymmetric layout of products. Some col-span-full md:col-span-8, some col-span-4. Large gaps (gap-8 to gap-12). Leave empty cells if needed for tension.
grids_and_layouts.product_details: Split layout: 50% left for sticky large image, 50% right for scrollable product info and AI try-on CTA. Use h-screen for sticky left.
grids_and_layouts.compare: Side-by-side strict grid (grid-cols-2) with synchronized scrolling or simple table layout for specs.
grids_and_layouts.navigation: Solid background bg-[#F9F9F6]/90 backdrop-blur-md with 1px bottom border. MUST NOT be transparent over content.

motion.hover: Images scale up slightly (scale-105) inside overflow-hidden container with transform 0.6s ease transition.
motion.page_transitions: Subtle fade and slight slide-up using framer-motion.
motion.ai_processing: Instead of generic spinners, use a 'scanning' line animation over the user's uploaded image (tracing beam effect) and monospace loading text (e.g., 'Analyzing room depth...').

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text color changes explicitly on hover. Text #525252 against #F9F9F6 meets APCA. Use #0033FF for clear focus rings.
accessibility.data_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

media.style: High fashion, minimalist architecture. Desaturated or high-contrast imagery.

specific_flows.virtual_try_on: 1. Upload/Capture Photo UX. 2. Validation layer (show checks for 'Full Body Detected', 'Good Lighting'). If fail, show [Retake]. 3. Processing State (framer-motion scanning effect + 'AI-generated representative visualization' microcopy). 4. Result composite.
specific_flows.room_visualization: Same as Try-on. Validation checks for 'Room corners detected', 'Floor visible'. AI Composite output.
specific_flows.assess_panel: A drawer or side panel that slides out, explaining the AI Match Score using technical but readable typography. E.g. 'Match 94% based on your recent searches for minimalist aesthetic.'
specific_flows.compare: Side-by-side view highlighting differences in dimensions, AI match scores, and price.

3d_libraries.recommendation: Use framer-motion for smooth 2D page transitions and the 'scanning' AI process overlay. No heavy 3D required for the core flow unless requested, keep it fast and responsive.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects carefully, but in this specific 'Editorial' theme, prefer solid surfaces with crisp 1px borders.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g. `transition: all`). Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file.
Always use modern button styles. For this theme, use sharp (rounded-none) edges.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use Phosphor or Lucide icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute.
